mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE date_range AS ( SELECT #{sdate} AS SNOW_DATE UNION ALL SELECT DATE_ADD(SNOW_DATE, INTERVAL 1 DAY) FROM date_range WHERE SNOW_DATE < #{edate} ) SELECT IFNULL(rh.SNOW, -99999) AS SNOW, dr.SNOW_DATE, DAYOFMONTH(dr.SNOW_DATE) AS NUM FROM date_range dr LEFT JOIN SNOW_HIST rh ON DATE(rh.SNOW_DATE) = dr.SNOW_DATE AND rh.DATA_TYPE = #{type} AND rh.AREA_CODE = #{area_code} ORDER BY dr.SNOW_DATE
